rules.name: SRTT domain cardinality
rules.requirement: Fixed source_entry_state=REVOKED and exactly 2304 variable tuples.

rules.name: SRTT tuple uniqueness
rules.requirement: Exactly one row per declared variable tuple; no duplicate input tuple.

rules.name: SRTT decisive rule membership
rules.requirement: Every row decisive_rule_id resolves to exactly one frozen SRTT-4 RuleRegistry rule.

rules.name: SRTT full semantic recomputation
rules.requirement: Recompute every row under frozen SRTT-4 precedence and require exact result/rule match.

rules.name: Guard identity
rules.requirement: Unique contiguous G001..G156; one ACTIVE record each.

rules.name: Case identity and guard references
rules.requirement: Unique case IDs; every positive/negative guard case exists; zero declared conflicts.

rules.name: Guard omission evidence recomputation
rules.requirement: For 11 embedded source excerpts recompute SHA-256 under declared basis, expand ranges, and require exact guard/case set equality.

rules.name: BSP structural authority
rules.requirement: Exactly one version-15 current-status block; semantic-test sections paired, non-nested, non-empty and ID-consistent; markers only standalone outside fences.

rules.name: Dependency graph closure
rules.requirement: All endpoints declared, no duplicate edge, acyclic, direct-edge semantics only.

rules.name: Evaluation order monotonicity
rules.requirement: No later stage consumes unqualified state or converts earlier blocker to authority without governed successor/recovery event.

rules.name: MTR authority freshness
rules.requirement: Live challenge exact-context match; single acceptance; <=30s verifier-monotonic age; no stale-token fallback.

rules.name: Canonical identity/quorum
rules.requirement: Alias-collapsed canonical subjects; only ACTIVE identities count; domain diversity cannot be manufactured by alias.

rules.name: Revocation temporal validity
rules.requirement: Current committed revocation state; UNREVOKE cannot validate prior revoked interval.

rules.name: AIEP authority profile
rules.requirement: Authority evaluator must be attested broker-only profile; UNATTESTED_RUNTIME cannot exercise authority roles.

rules.name: AIM Smax before permission/lifecycle filtering
rules.requirement: Compute Smax over full effective matching set; invalid permission at Smax blocks lower fallback.

rules.name: RIR exact temporal tuple
rules.requirement: Exactly one temporally eligible ACTIVE RIR tuple matching policy, implementation, runtime, workload and suite.

rules.name: RCS freshness
rules.requirement: Only current PASS for exact bound tuple; stale/failed/expired/unavailable evidence cannot qualify or fall back.

rules.name: Semantic Smax and ANY
rules.requirement: Compute semantic Smax before lifecycle; validate current ANY at Smax; no lower fallback.

rules.name: Multi-revoked composition
rules.requirement: Every revoked blocker uniquely discharges before selection; partial discharge never grants authority; final SREP comparison is set-based and order-independent.

rules.name: Authority read-set sealing
rules.requirement: Every mutable authority input is registered, captured, bound into DPS and final seal; state change before commit => STATE_CHANGED and no effect intent.

rules.name: Qualified time proof
rules.requirement: Single-use 256-bit nonce, same DPS digest, source validity at sequence, at least 2 distinct qualified sources of reference population 3; no local-clock/cached/weaker fallback.

rules.name: Effect success boundary
rules.requirement: Only SUCCEEDED_RECONCILED is success; ambiguous/unverified provider outcomes are never success; retries reuse idempotency key.

rules.name: Evidence strength
rules.requirement: Strong evidence requires qualified producer/runtime and exact derivation; rewrapping cannot upgrade class; missing/contradictory mandatory evidence blocks.

rules.name: Migration authority boundary
rules.requirement: Stable constitution+tenant+object identity; complete object map; fresh destination policy; widening requires fresh destination authorization; cross-constitution import carries no authority.

rules.name: Recovery anti-replay
rules.requirement: Predeclared trigger, current context, single-use nonce, lawful quorum/current trust; unavailable lawful path never creates weaker emergency root.

rules.name: No optional authority bypass
rules.requirement: Missing required authority field is validation failure, never default/fallback authority.
